spans.s: गृह (I) n. 1. A house, a habitation, a mansion, R.iii.11, M.ii.34, iii.33, ix.89; 2. a wife, e.g. न गृहं गृहमित्याहुर्गृहिणी गृहमुच्यते; 3. the inhabitants of a house; 4. a sign of the zodiac; 5. a name, an appellation.
गृह (II) m. pl. 1. A house, a mansion, इमे नो गृहाः Mud.i. or तत्रागारं धनपति गृहानुत्तरेणास्मदीयम् Megh.ii.12; 2. a wife.
गृह-अक्ष m. a loop-hole, a round or oblong window.
गृह-अधिप, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. a householder; 2. a regent of a sign of the zodiac.
गृह-अधिप, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. a householder; 2. a regent of a sign of the zodiac.
गृह-अधिप, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. a householder; 2. a regent of a sign of the zodiac.
गृह-अयनिक m. a householder.
गृह-अर्थ m. household affairs, any household matter, गृहार्थोऽग्निपरिष्क्रिया M.ii.67.
गृह-अम्ल n. a kind of sour gruel.
गृह-अवग्रहणी f. the threshold.
गृह-अश्मन् m. a flat oblong stone upon which condiments are ground.
गृह-आराम m. a garden attached to a house.
गृह-आश्रम m. the order of a householder, the second stage in the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa.
गृह-आश्रमिन् m. a householder.
गृह-उत्पात m. any domestic nuisance.
गृह-उपकरण n. a domestic utensil, anything required for household purposes, मातर्गृहोपकरणमद्य हि नास्तीति साधितं त्वया K.Pr.ii.
गृह-कच्छप m. the same as गृहाश्मन् q.v.
गृह-कपोत, -कपोतक m. a tame domestic pigeon.
गृह-कपोत, -कपोतक m. a tame domestic pigeon.
गृह-करण n. 1. household affairs; 2. house building.
गृह-कर्मन् m. household affairs.
गृह-कर्मन्˚दास m. a domestic servant, शंभुस्वयंभुहरयो हरिणेक्षणानां येनाक्रियंत सततं गृहकर्मदासाः Bhartr.i.1.
गृह-कलह m. domestic disunion.
गृह-कारक m. a house builder, a mason, Yaj.iii.146.
गृह-कुक्कुट m. a domestic cock.
गृह-कार्य n. household affairs, M.v.150.
गृह-चूल्ली f. a house consisting of two rooms contiguous to each other but one facing west, the other east.
गृह-च्छिद्र n. a family secret or scandal.
गृह-ज, -जात m. a slave born in the house.
गृह-ज, -जात m. a slave born in the house.
गृह-जालिका f. deceit, disguise.
गृहज्ञानिन् m. wise only in the house, i.e. ignorant, stupid.
गृहज्ञानिन् m. wise only in the house, i.e. ignorant, stupid.
गृह-तटी f. a terrace in front of the house.
गृह-दास m. a domestic slave.
गृह-देवता (I) f. the goddess of a house.
गृह-देवता (II) f. pl. a class of household deities.
गृह-देहली f. the threshold of a house, यासां बलिः सपदि मद्गृहदेहलीनाम् Mrich.i.
गृह-नमन n. wind.
गृह-नाशन m. a wild pigeon.
गृह-नीड m. a sparrow.
गृह-पति m. 1. a householder, a man in the second stage of life, who, after having completed his studies is married and settled; 2. an adviser; 3. a sacrificer.
गृह-पाल m. 1. the guardian of a house; 2. a house-dog.
गृह-पोतक m. the site of a habitation, the ground on which it stands and which surrounds it.
गृह-प्रवेश m. solemn entrance into a house according to prescribed rites.
गृह-बभ्रु m. a domestic ichneumon.
गृह-बलि m. a domestic offering to all creatures, to supernatural beings and to household deities, M.iii.265.
गृह-बलि˚भुज् m. 1. a crow; 2. a sparrow, नीडारंभैर्गृहबलिभुजामाकुलग्रामचैत्याः Megh.i.23, (गृहबलिभुजां काकादिग्रामपक्षिणाम् Mall.).
गृह-बलि˚देवता f. a deity to whom a domestic oblation is offered.
गृह-भंग m. 1. one who is driven from his house; 2. destroying a house, breaking into a house; 3. failure, ruin or destruction of a family.
गृह-भूमि f. the site of a house.
गृह-भेदिन् a. prying into domestic affairs, causing family quarrels.
गृह-मणि m. a lamp.
गृह-माचिका f. a bat.
गृह-मृग m. a dog.
गृह-मेध m. 1. a householder; 2. a domestic sacrifice.
गृह-मेधिन् m. a householder, प्रजाते गृहमेधिनाम् R.i.7 (See गृहपति).
गृह-यंत्र n. a stick to which, on solemn occasions, flags are fastened, गृहयंत्रपताकाश्रीरपौरादरनिर्मिता K.S.vi.41.
गृह-वाटिका, -वाटी f. a garden near a house.
गृह-वाटिका, -वाटी f. a garden near a house.
गृह-वित्त m. the owner of a house.
गृह-शया m. a threshold.
गृह-शुक m. a domestic parrot, one kept for pleasure, Am.
गृह-संवेशक m. a house-builder by profession.
गृह-स्थ m. a householder, M.iii.61, 78. See गृहपति.
गृह-स्थ˚आश्रम m. the life of a householder. See गृहाश्रम.
गृह-स्थ˚धर्म m. the duty of a householder.
गृहयाय्य m. A householder (गृहयाप्य is a wrong form of this word).
गृहयालु a. disposed to lay hold of.
गृहिणी f. A wife (generally in charge of the house, यांत्येवं गृहिणीपदं यवतयो वामाः कुलस्याधयः Sak.iv., R.viii.67.
गृहिणी-पद n. the position of the mistress of the house.
गृहिन् m. The master of a house, a householder, पीड्यंते गृहिणः कथं नु तनयाविश्लेषदुःखैर्नवैः Sak.iv., Sant.S.ii.24.
गृहीत a. (f. ता) 1. Taken, seized, गृहीत इव केशेषु मृत्युना धर्ममाचरेत् Hit.i.; 2. accepted; 3. obtained, attained; 4. worn, (pp. of ग्रह् q.v.).
गृहीत a. (f. ता) 1. Taken, seized, गृहीत इव केशेषु मृत्युना धर्ममाचरेत् Hit.i.; 2. accepted; 3. obtained, attained; 4. worn, (pp. of ग्रह् q.v.).
गृहीत-गर्भा f. a pregrant woman.
गृहीत-दिश् a. 1. run away, dispersed; 2. disappeared.
गृहीतिन् a. (f. नी) Who has comprehended, (with a loc.), e.g. गृहीती षट्स्वंगेषु.
गृहीतिन् a. (f. नी) Who has comprehended, (with a loc.), e.g. गृहीती षट्स्वंगेषु.

गृह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) 1. To be attracted or pleased, गुणगृह्या वचने विपश्चिनः Kir.ii.5; 2. belonging to a house; 3. dependent; 4. domesticated; 5. situated outside of, e.g. ग्रामगृह्या सेना ‘an army outside a village.’
गृह्य (II) m. 1. The inmate of a house; 2. a tame animal.
गृह्य (III) n. The anus.

गृह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) 1. To be attracted or pleased, गुणगृह्या वचने विपश्चिनः Kir.ii.5; 2. belonging to a house; 3. dependent; 4. domesticated; 5. situated outside of, e.g. ग्रामगृह्या सेना ‘an army outside a village.’
गृह्या f. A village adjoining to a city.
गृह्य-अग्नि m. a sacred fire which is incumbent on every Brāhmaṇa householder to keep.
